motion.name: assembly

controlDensity.geometry: Pill actions, single-line fields, and selectors; 16px panels and multiline text areas. No squared shape variants, compatibility aliases, or resting outlines. Minimum heights grow for content.

selectPopup.purpose: Keep option hover fills away from the popup edge while retaining compact rows and soft overlay elevation.
selectPopup.ghostActiveForeground: Default-tone ghost trigger uses primary foreground on hover and while open, with surface-hover fill and a rotating chevron.

actionPopover.purpose: Match the Select viewport gutter and keep hover fills away from panel edges.

nativeSelect.geometry: Pill trigger with surface or quiet fill and a decorative Tabler chevron; popup remains browser-owned. Multiple-selection and listbox forms omit the chevron.

typographyScale.content: 14/22.75px, weight 400 for Page and document prose
typographyScale.tracking: Normal product tracking; distinct brand and marketing treatments
typographyScale.configuration: Inherited --text-ui, --text-body, --text-content, and --text-code tokens with independent line-height tokens; use semantic roles.

selectionControls.geometry: Round native checkbox and radio inputs, pill question rows
selectionControls.state: Checkmark for checkbox multiple selection; inner dot for radio single selection; native form and keyboard semantics
selectionControls.separator: 8px spatial boundary without a stroke; nondecorative boundaries retain native separator semantics; DaySeparator has no flank lines

navigationResizeHandle.purpose: Visible functional interactive boundary; stroke-free content separators remain unchanged.

iconography.loading: Tabler loader used by Button and LoadingStatus; rotation respects reduced motion

assistantComposition.textarea: 16/24px with surface-muted default fill; bare appearance is transparent in a containing surface
assistantComposition.composer: Muted tonal root with 12px insets and 8px gaps; bare editor starts at 44px and grows to a bounded height; icon-only attachment action left and icon-only send with other actions right; bare editor has no inner outline and root owns soft focus shadow; send minimum 36px, coarse-pointer targets 44px
assistantComposition.integratedContext: Slash/mention pickers, attachments, and dictation context compose inside ComposerRoot. Pickers have a 4px inner gutter; host selection updates the draft, closes the picker, and restores editor focus. Empty attachments render no placeholder.
assistantComposition.disclosure: TaskCard transcript disclosure uses native semantics, tonal fill, and 12px content insets with 4px top spacing; no open-state dividing line

assistantReferenceContracts.streamingText: Host supplies segments, count, and streaming; word arrival fades over 500ms and primary accent settles over 700ms.
assistantReferenceContracts.streamingTextReveal: Complete text reveals two graphemes every 9ms, steady active caret, 1s idle blink; reduced motion displays complete text with steady caret.
assistantReferenceContracts.reasoningEffort: Labeled budget segments, selected value, actual spent usage; optional onChange makes segments interactive.
assistantReferenceContracts.reasoningEffortSlider: Controlled native range with continuous drag, discrete stops, morphing thumb and label shoulder; optional actual usage.
assistantReferenceContracts.messageActions: Controlled votes, acknowledged copy, reactions, searchable emoji groups, reply, optional read-aloud/fork/report, and caller-formatted timestamp.
assistantReferenceContracts.thinkingReasoning: Host supplies sentences and real thinking/completed phase; demonstration timing does not represent execution.
assistantReferenceContracts.verification: Inventory and source comparison describe coverage and implementation targets; browser checks and user validation remain separate.

rules.body: Use compatible Syntropika details only where they strengthen the composition.

rules.name: Connected product scenes
rules.body: Marketing examples show a person's question, authorized context, an Agent contribution, and a human decision in a clear narrative order.

rules.name: The Open Session Canvas Rule
rules.body: Navigation uses a 52px rail starting with Home and Dashboard, alongside a resizable sidebar starting at 288px. Pinned navigation moves the canvas, closed navigation leaves the 52px rail, and hovering Home reveals a temporary layer at x56/y4 without reflow or keyboard focus changes; clicking Home starts a new unpersisted conversation while preserving pinned or closed canvas geometry. ArrowRight opens keyboard preview and Escape dismisses it with Home focus. Pointer crossing grace retains preview while the pointer or keyboard focus stays inside. The header pins temporary navigation or closes pinned navigation. A 16px full-height resize target permits sidebar widths 238px to 468px and deliberate drag-to-close, preserving the chosen width during the browser session. Dashboard opens the central view; Home starts a new unpersisted conversation and New Conversation also remains in the sidebar; Projects and Tasks controls are absent. The Workspace name in the contextual header opens a compact action popup with a rotating Tabler chevron and a visible hover/expanded fill; there is no Workspace icon in the rail. Switching opens an adjacent second-level submenu on hover, retaining click and keyboard access, with actual memberships and creation below the list. Selecting the current Workspace restores its contextual sidebar without changing the conversation. Workspace settings remain disabled until supported; invitations identify the current member-management limitation. A separate bottom account avatar popup shows real identity, Settings, and Sign out. Both share ActionPopover parts. Appearance stays in account settings and the public footer. Settings uses the same NavigationSidebar and NavigationShell with the chosen width, header height, and spacing, replacing history with General, Appearance, Security and sign-in, and Account, with one real section in the central canvas. The Settings header has no Workspace selector. Its sidebar stays pinned at the desktop breakpoint without collapse, resize, or back actions; mobile keeps its drawer. General offers supported languages or automatic browser detection. New Conversation opens an unpersisted composer; the first valid send creates the Session and posts its contribution with exact idempotent recovery. Section changes preserve the open conversation. The contextual sheet has rounded left corners over a darker rail, with a notification icon and collapse control in its header. Invitations belong to the Workspace popup. Sessions fill the central canvas without a visible top header. The history viewport spans its full width with the scrollbar at the far right, while message rows and the independently anchored two-row composer retain a centered 768px measure. Light uses surface-hover #DEDAD3, selected primary-soft #DFE7F1, muted text #555D67, and control outlines #747A83. All surfaces use shared Dusty Blue light and neutral charcoal dark tokens with a persistent Light, Dark, or System choice applied before first paint. A floating action opens Session metadata and participant context without reflow. Below 768px, a floating navigation action opens the focus-contained drawer.

rules.name: The Working Surface Radius Rule
rules.body: Focused account, authentication, onboarding, and Workspace overview areas deliberately inherit the existing 16px panel radius through Surface. Choose a flat tonal surface or soft raised shadow through its elevation variant, and spacing through its inset variant. Session history remains open on the canvas; its composer owns a rounded muted surface and soft focus shadow. This extension does not change ordinary control, context, or other panel radii.

rules.name: The Entry Capsule Rule
rules.body: Authentication and Workspace setup fields use the shared large Input variant (44px minimum height), with round main form actions at the same height. Large trailing-adornment fields reserve 48px on the right for their separate action. Dense operational forms keep the default Input control shape and size; compact secondary actions can use round geometry without adopting the main form action's height.

rules.name: Confirmed model choice
rules.body: In the compact composer action row, the Session creator chooses a model through the shared Select parts, with catalog options grouped by provider; other participants see the saved model as a read-only label. The confirmed saved selection remains authoritative while a change is pending. Disable changes during active generation or conflicting mutations, and keep loading, errors, and recovery actions above the composer at full width.

rules.name: The Compact Control Scale Rule
rules.body: Existing and new components use 28–44px minimum heights, pill control geometry, 16px panel corners, natural content growth, no resting outlines, and 44px coarse-pointer targets.

dos: Keep participation inviting and responsibility legible.
Use rounded controls and measured elevation where they clarify the landing hierarchy.
donts: Do not equate Agent identity color with execution status.
Do not turn decoration into an unagreed domain model.
Do not repeat flat split panels or identical cards as the landing's whole structure.
